 Alperen Sengun plays well in win Monday 
 by Leo Sells | Rockets Correspondent | Tue, Nov 10th 2026, 12:05pm EST 
 Alperen Sengun scored 20 points (9-17 FG, 1-3 3PT, 1-3 FT) to go with 12 rebounds and eight assists in Monday night's 110-100 win over the Denver Nuggets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 The big man fell just two assists shy of recording a 20-point triple-double on Monday night. He ended with a fantastic fantasy total as a result, which fantasy managers should be very happy with at this point in the season.
